headline: BSP Raises Key Policy Rate by 25 Basis Points to 5 Percent
seoTitle: BSP Raises Policy Rate to 5% | FMB News
seoDescription: The Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas raised its target reverse repurchase rate by 25 basis points to 5 percent.
deck: The central bank tightened policy by another quarter point as it responded to inflation and exchange-rate pressures.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: The Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas raised the target reverse repurchase rate by 25 basis points to 5 percent in its latest monetary-policy decision.
Rates on the overnight deposit and lending facilities were adjusted alongside the policy move.

sections.heading: Why the BSP acted
paragraphs: The Monetary Board pointed to persistent inflation risks, elevated global energy costs and peso weakness as reasons for maintaining a tighter policy stance.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: Higher policy rates can raise borrowing costs for households and businesses while helping restrain inflation and support the currency.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Markets will watch the next inflation prints, peso movement and BSP guidance for signs of whether further tightening will be needed.
